description.zh: 把助手的回复写成「豆包语」：高能前置的形容词排比、疗愈式诊断、否定清单、复读与服务化收尾。双通道工作——系统提示词注入风格规范，回复结束时再补一段外壳，保证风格稳定落地。五档强度、全部参数可调、自定义词条优先、固定种子可复现预览、配置快照与回滚。只改输出风格，不改角色设定、权限与工具行为。
description.en: Writes assistant replies in Doubao style: an energetic adjective barrage up front, therapeutic diagnoses, a negation inventory, deliberate repetition, and a service-flavored closing question. Two channels work together: a style specification injected into the system prompt, plus a tail shell appended when a response finishes, so the style lands even when the model ignores instructions. Five intensity levels, every knob adjustable, custom entries prioritized, seed-reproducible previews, and configuration snapshots with rollback. Output style only; character, permissions, and tool behavior stay untouched.

description.zh: doubao_status / doubao_configure / doubao_render / doubao_lexicon：让模型查看当前档位、调整参数、把一段文本渲染成豆包语、读取词库规模。
description.en: doubao_status / doubao_configure / doubao_render / doubao_lexicon: lets the model inspect the active level, adjust parameters, render arbitrary text into Doubao style, and read lexicon sizes.
